ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:1 ratio of low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels concentrated in the central and medial regions to high-intensity white/light-grey pixels on the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central chevron is dominated by a continuous low-intensity black region. Lateral lobes (left and right) display a high-intensity white base with high-frequency low-intensity speckling (mottling). The far right lobe tip features three distinct, large, circular low-intensity blobs.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending roughly 25% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged 'peaks' are visible on the distal half of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the leading edges of both lobes, with the trailing edge showing a generally concave sweep from the tip toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of approximately 30-40 small, high-intensity (yellow-white) circular pixel clusters localized within the central dark pigment area, suggesting barnacle colonization points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct sets of parallel, dark-pigmented linear marks (rake marks) on the upper lateral region of the left lobe, and several smaller diagonal scratches on the medial right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch (likely a healed amputation or trauma) located on the outer third of the right lobe's trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A series of roughly five prominent, dark circular spots of varying sizes (approx. 20-50 pixels in diameter) on the high-intensity background of the right lobe tip.
